Bash(.specify/scripts/powershell/create-new-feature.ps1 -Json "Create a new feature specification for the basic in-memory todo console app.

Feature name: basic-in-memory-todo-app

Requirements:
- Add tasks with title and description
- View/list all tasks with status indicators \(e.g., [ ] pending, [x] complete\) and IDs
- Update task title or description by ID
- Delete task by ID
- Mark task as complete or incomplete by ID

The app runs as a simple interactive command-line loop with commands like: add, list, update <id>, delete <id>, complete <id>, quit.

Include user stories, acceptance criteria, review checklist, and any edge cases \(e.g., invalid ID, empty list\).

Generate the full spec.md in the appropriate specs folder." -Json -Number 1 -ShortName "todo-app")

Bash(.specify/scripts/powershell/setup-plan.ps1 -Json "### /sp.plan

Based on the approved fullstack-todo-phase2.md specification and constitution, create a technical implementation plan \(plan-phase2.md\).

Structure:

1. Monorepo folder structure proposal \(confirm or adjust the recommended Spec-Kit structure\)
2. Database schema \(users + tasks tables, relationships, indexes\)
3. Authentication architecture & flow \(Better Auth → JWT → FastAPI verification\)
4. Backend breakdown:
   • Main modules/files to create/modify
   • Middleware for auth
   • Dependency injection approach
   • CRUD route handlers
5. Frontend breakdown:
   • Pages / App Router structure
   • Auth components & hooks
   • API client implementation
   • Main UI components
6. Environment variables needed
7. Development workflow commands \(dev frontend, dev backend, both\)
8. Testing approach for this phase \(mainly manual + basic endpoint testing\)

Prioritize implementation order recommendation:
\(1\) Database & models
\(2\) Auth middleware & basic protected route
\(3\) Task CRUD backend
\(4\) Auth frontend integration
\(5\) Task UI frontend

Reference relevant spec sections with @ notation.")

Bash(powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .specify/scripts/powershell/create-new-feature.ps1 -Json "Create a new feature specification file for the intermediate organization & usability improvements.

Suggested file path: @specs/features/intermediate-org-usability.md

Feature title: Intermediate - Priorities, Tags, Search, Filter & Sorting

This specification builds on the existing multi-user task CRUD with authentication.

New capabilities to implement:

1. Task Priorities
   - Priority levels: high, medium \(default\), low
   - Stored as string enum or lowercase string
   - Visible in task list \(colored badges preferred: red/orange/green\)

2. Tags / Categories
   - Multiple tags per task \(array of strings\)
   - Free-text, user-defined \(no predefined list required\)
   - Common examples: work, personal, urgent, shopping, health
   - Display as comma-separated pills/badges in UI

3. Search
   - Full-text search by keyword in title AND description \(case insensitive\)
   - Dedicated search input field on main task list page

4. Filtering
   - Filter by:
     - status \(all / pending / completed\)
     - priority \(all / high / medium / low\)
     - one or multiple tags \(contains any of selected tags\)
   - Filters should be combinable \(AND logic\)
   - UI: dropdowns / multi-select chips / toggle buttons

5. Sorting
   - Sort options:
     - created date \(newest/oldest\) – default
     - due date \(soonest/latest, nulls last\)
     - priority \(high → medium → low\)
     - alphabetically by title
   - UI: dropdown selector on task list page

Technical requirements:
• All new fields must be added to database schema \(tasks table\)
• Backend must support filtering, searching and sorting via query parameters
• API should remain RESTful and respect user ownership
• Frontend should update task list in real-time after filter/sort/search changes \(client-side if reasonable, or refetch\)

Include:
- Updated task data model
- New/updated query parameters for GET /api/tasks
- Acceptance criteria per feature
- UI/UX guidelines & suggested visual patterns
- Security/validation considerations
- Review checklist

After creation, sug" -Number 1 -ShortName "intermediate-org-usability" "Intermediate organization & usability improvements")
